content.json:
# AKS / Containers

Monitors Kubernetes cluster health — node/pod CPU, restarts, CrashLoopBackOff, node status, and PV usage — reading from **AKS_CL**.

content.query:
let _binSize = 5m;
AKS_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where isnotempty(NodeName)
| summarize
    AvgNodeCpu    = avg(NodeCpuPercent),
    MaxNodeCpu    = max(NodeCpuPercent),
    AvgNodeMemPct = avg(NodeMemoryPercent)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, _binSize), Resource, NodeName, Environment
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Node CPU & Memory % Over Time

content.query:
AKS_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where isnotempty(PodName)
| summarize
    AvgPodCpu    = avg(PodCpuPercent),
    AvgPodMemPct = avg(PodMemoryPercent)
    by Resource, Namespace, PodName, Environment
| top 20 by AvgPodCpu desc
content.title: Top 20 Pods by CPU (Last 1h)

content.query:
let _binSize = 5m;
AKS_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where isnotempty(PodName)
| summarize MaxRestarts = max(PodRestartCount)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, _binSize), Resource, Namespace, PodName, Environment
| order by MaxRestarts desc
content.title: Pod Restarts Over Time

content.query:
AKS_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where PodReason == "CrashLoopBackOff" or PodPhase == "Failed"
| summarize
    FirstSeen   = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen    = max(TimeGenerated),
    MaxRestarts = max(PodRestartCount),
    Occurrences = count()
    by Resource, Namespace, PodName, PodReason, Environment
| order by MaxRestarts desc
content.title: CrashLoopBackOff / Failed Pods

content.query:
AKS_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where isnotempty(NodeName)
| summarize LastReported = max(TimeGenerated), arg_max(TimeGenerated, NodeStatus)
    by Resource, NodeName, Environment
| extend IsNotReady = NodeStatus != "Ready"
| project Resource, NodeName, Environment, NodeStatus, IsNotReady, LastReported
| order by IsNotReady desc
content.title: Node Status

content.query:
AKS_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where isnotempty(PVName)
| summarize AvgPVUsage = avg(PVUsagePercent), MaxPVUsage = max(PVUsagePercent)
    by Resource, Namespace, PodName, PVName, Environment
| extend Severity = case(
    MaxPVUsage >= 90.0, "Critical",
    MaxPVUsage >= 80.0, "Warning",
    "OK")
| order by MaxPVUsage desc
content.title: PersistentVolume Usage
